with src as (
    select * from "price_analytics"."raw"."crawl_product_price"
),

parsed as (
    select
        raw_id,
        platform,
        source_url,
        crawled_at,
        crawl_date,
        crawler_version,
        data_source,
        product_name,
        breadcrumb,
        -- "Rp 14.500" / "Rp14.500" -> 14500
        nullif(regexp_replace(price_text, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric          as price_idr,
        nullif(regexp_replace(original_price_text, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric as original_price_idr,
        -- "9%" -> 9 ; "-10%" -> -10 (nilai di luar 0..100 dibiarkan agar bisa ditandai)
        nullif(substring(discount_text from '-?[0-9]+'), '')::numeric               as discount_pct_raw,
        lower(product_name)                                                         as name_lower,
        regexp_match(lower(product_name), '(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*(ml|kg|g|l|pcs)(?![a-z])')                           as size_m
    from src
),

sized as (
    select
        *,
        replace(size_m[1], ',', '.')::numeric as size_qty,
        size_m[2]                             as size_unit
    from parsed
),

normalized as (
    select
        *,
        -- satuan dasar: ml (dari ml, L), g (dari g, kg), pcs
        round(case size_unit when 'l' then size_qty * 1000
                             when 'kg' then size_qty * 1000
                             else size_qty end)::int as pack_qty_base,
        case size_unit when 'l' then 'ml' when 'ml' then 'ml'
                       when 'kg' then 'g' when 'g' then 'g'
                       when 'pcs' then 'pcs' end      as pack_unit_base,
        -- nama tanpa ukuran, tanpa tanda baca
        trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(name_lower, '(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*(ml|kg|g|l|pcs)(?![a-z])', ' '), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g')) as name_clean
    from sized
),

keyed as (
    select
        n.*,
        -- kumpulan kata unik (tanpa kata promosi), diurutkan, sehingga urutan kata tidak berpengaruh
        (select string_agg(distinct t, ' ' order by t)
           from unnest(string_to_array(n.name_clean, ' ')) as t
          where t <> ''
            and t not in ('official', 'store', 'isi', 'lebih', 'promo', 'pack', 'unilever')) as name_key
    from normalized n
)

select
    raw_id, platform, source_url, crawled_at, crawl_date, crawler_version, data_source,
    product_name, breadcrumb, price_idr, original_price_idr, discount_pct_raw,
    pack_qty_base, pack_unit_base, name_clean, name_key,
    name_key || '|' || coalesce(pack_qty_base::text, 'na') || coalesce(pack_unit_base, 'na') as match_key
from keyed

with ranked as (
    select
        s.*,
        row_number() over (
            partition by platform, source_url, crawl_date
            order by crawled_at desc, raw_id desc
        ) as rn
    from "price_analytics"."silver"."stg_crawl_product_price" s
),

latest as (
    select * from ranked where rn = 1
),

branded as (
    select
        l.*,
        (select b.brand from "price_analytics"."silver"."brands" b
          where ' ' || l.name_clean || ' ' like '% ' || lower(b.brand) || ' %'
          order by length(b.brand) desc limit 1) as brand,
        c.category as category_from_breadcrumb
    from latest l
    left join "price_analytics"."silver"."category_map" c
           on c.platform = l.platform and c.breadcrumb = l.breadcrumb
),

checked as (
    select
        *,
        case
            when price_idr is null                                         then 'price_missing'
            when price_idr <= 0                                            then 'price_not_positive'
            when discount_pct_raw is not null
                 and (discount_pct_raw < 0 or discount_pct_raw > 100)      then 'discount_out_of_range'
            when original_price_idr is not null
                 and price_idr > original_price_idr                        then 'price_gt_original'
        end as dq_issue
    from branded
)

select
    md5(platform || '|' || source_url)                         as listing_key,
    md5(match_key)                                             as product_key,
    platform,
    source_url,
    crawl_date,
    crawled_at,
    product_name,
    brand,
    category_from_breadcrumb,
    pack_qty_base,
    pack_unit_base,
    match_key,
    price_idr,
    coalesce(original_price_idr, price_idr)                    as original_price_idr,
    case when price_idr > 0 and coalesce(original_price_idr, price_idr) >= price_idr
         then round((1 - price_idr / coalesce(original_price_idr, price_idr)) * 100, 1)
         else 0 end                                            as discount_pct,
    dq_issue,
    (dq_issue is null)                                         as is_valid,
    data_source,
    raw_id
from checked

with obs as (
    select * from "price_analytics"."silver"."silver_price_observation"
),

names as (
    select
        product_key, product_name,
        row_number() over (
            partition by product_key
            order by case platform when 'Blibli' then 1 when 'Klik Indomaret' then 2 else 3 end,
                     crawled_at, raw_id
        ) as rn
    from obs
),

agg as (
    select
        product_key,
        max(match_key)                         as match_key,
        max(brand)                             as brand,
        max(category_from_breadcrumb)          as category,
        max(pack_qty_base)                     as pack_qty_base,
        max(pack_unit_base)                    as pack_unit_base,
        count(distinct platform)               as n_platforms,
        min(crawl_date)                        as first_seen_date
    from obs
    group by product_key
)

select
    a.product_key,
    n.product_name as canonical_name,
    a.brand,
    a.category,
    a.pack_qty_base,
    a.pack_unit_base,
    a.pack_qty_base::text || ' ' || a.pack_unit_base as pack_size,
    a.n_platforms,
    a.first_seen_date,
    a.match_key
from agg a
join names n on n.product_key = a.product_key and n.rn = 1
